name: Feedback local store
purpose: Own the on-disk feedback log at .rcf/feedback/entries.jsonl (append-only, one JSON object per line, folded by id), the per-session ask ledger at .rcf/feedback/state.json, and the outbox bundle directory .rcf/feedback/outbox/. Contribute the gitignore entry so the store never rides a git push.
responsibilities: Append entry and state lines atomically with no reader ever seeing a partial line
Fold entries.jsonl by id, last line wins, when returning current state
Export feedbackGitignoreEntry so managed-gitignore aggregation picks up the path on doctor --fix
Refuse a first write when the gitignore does not cover .rcf/feedback/ and --force is absent
Provide state helpers for asked-records, deferred-until-session, discarded, submitted and bundled transitions
internalStructure: src/feedback/store.js exposes readEntries(root), appendEntry(root, entry), appendState(root, transition) and readSettings(root); a small ensureGitignore(root, opts) enforces the pre-write check. Outbox writes go through a separate helper that computes the filename from the destination slug and the ISO timestamp.

interfaces.name: readEntries
interfaces.description: Load and fold the JSONL log to current-state entries.

interfaces.name: appendEntry
interfaces.description: Append one entry object as a JSONL line.

interfaces.name: appendState
interfaces.description: Append one state-transition line for an existing id.

dependencies.name: node:fs/promises
dependencies.description: Filesystem I/O; the store is deliberately synchronous where safe.

tradeoffs: Append-only JSONL is trivial to write correctly and to inspect by eye; the cost is a fold on every read, which is negligible at the entry counts a single project will ever see.
notes: Gitignored, not committed. Raw entries can hold what redaction removes; committing them would leak on the next push for a public project.
